verdict.rationale: Governance and funding transparency is a fair question for an open-source game engine, so the axis applies. The pack establishes only that PlayCanvas is an open-source, MIT-licensed engine with paid plans. It never mentions a foundation, published finances, or a public roadmap. A former employee's informal note about upcoming ES6 module support is not a published roadmap, and open-source licensing is an adjacent feature, not governance transparency.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project's governance and funding are transparent — a foundation, published finances, or a public roadmap I can plan against
